zh.explain: 高高的宝塔神异奇特，八面透亮，永放光芒。劝您多多虔诚地顶礼膜拜，多做善事，上天自会赐给您幸福吉祥。
divination: 世上的这些福分，大家都是经常见到的。
不要劳心费力地追求，一切都是人在前世就修定了的。
zh.summary: 此卦福德现身之象。所祈求之事非常吉祥顺利。

verse: The majestic pagoda is more than ordinary,
In all directions, it glows exquisitely.
Steel your mind to worship and do more good,
Heaven will reward your charity with fortune.
interpretation: Your share of fortune is much the same as others.
Do not fret as this is all preordained.
meaning: The signs of fortune and prosperity, everything will go very well.
en.explain: Unique and extraordinary, the majestic pagoda stands tall, shining constantly in all 8 directions with brilliance. It is advisable for you to devote yourself to earnest worship, do more virtuous deeds, then Heaven will naturally bless you with good fortune and happiness.
divination: All these worldly good fortunes, everyone sees it frequently. Do not expend a great deal of effort chasing after it. Everything is predestined in previous life.
items: Need to make vow before Bodhisattva
Best to print sutras to increase merits & wisdom
Cultivate merits & wisdom to help in exams
Do vast offerings for blessings and dedications

notes: 17 items: no 寻失物 / Missing things item on either page; adds 迁徙搬家 / Migrating and moving house. zh jieyue prints 福份 while divination prints 福分 (both kept as printed).
